SELECT w.id AS workation_id, w.region_id, w.start_date, w.end_date,
(SELECT SUM(b.target_amount) FROM budgets b JOIN expense_categories ec ON ec.id = b.expense_category_id WHERE b.workation_id = w.id AND b.budget_type = 'PERSONAL' AND ec.code = 'FOOD') AS food_budget, (SELECT so.option_code FROM user_surveys us JOIN user_survey_answers usa ON usa.survey_id = us.id JOIN survey_options so ON so.id = usa.option_id JOIN survey_questions sq ON sq.id = so.question_id WHERE us.id = AND sq.question_code = 'Q1' ORDER BY usa.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS priority_option_code, (SELECT so.option_name FROM user_surveys us JOIN user_survey_answers usa ON usa.survey_id = us.id JOIN survey_options so ON so.id = usa.option_id JOIN survey_questions sq ON sq.id = so.question_id WHERE us.id = AND sq.question_code = 'Q1' ORDER BY usa.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS priority_option_name, (SELECT so.option_code FROM user_surveys us JOIN user_survey_answers usa ON usa.survey_id = us.id JOIN survey_options so ON so.id = usa.option_id JOIN survey_questions sq ON sq.id = so.question_id WHERE us.id = AND sq.question_code = 'Q4' ORDER BY usa.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS meal_style_option_code, (SELECT so.option_name FROM user_surveys us JOIN user_survey_answers usa ON usa.survey_id = us.id JOIN survey_options so ON so.id = usa.option_id JOIN survey_questions sq ON sq.id = so.question_id WHERE us.id = AND sq.question_code = 'Q4' ORDER BY usa.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS meal_style_option_name FROM workations w WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY w.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.rating, m.latitude, m.longitude FROM merchants m WHERE m.region_id = #{regionId} AND m.category = 'RESTAURANT' ORDER BY m.id ASC

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category, m.latitude, m.longitude, 1 AS reserved FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rp.merchant_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.workation_id = #{workationId} AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category, m.latitude, m.longitude, 1 AS reserved FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rp.merchant_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.workation_id = #{workationId} AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND m.category = 'OFFICE' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category, m.latitude, m.longitude FROM merchants m WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND m.region_id = #{regionId} AND m.category IN ('ACCOMMODATION', 'OFFICE', 'ACTIVITY')

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category, m.latitude, m.longitude, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.workation_id = #{workationId} AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND rp.merchant_id = m.id) AS reserved FROM merchants m WHERE m.region_id = #{regionId} AND m.category IN ('ACCOMMODATION', 'OFFICE', 'ACTIVITY') ORDER BY reserved DESC, m.category ASC, m.id ASC
